# NextGenergy

> Prefabricated Liquid Cooling and Field Services for AI Data Centres. NextGenergy plans and designs liquid-cooled AI data centres and delivers them as prefabricated skids, CDUs, ORv3 racks and cooling plant. In Canada it also provides field testing, commissioning and operations for the liquid cooling loop, with the evidence for every boundary.

NextGenergy (NextGenergy Technology Inc.) is based in Toronto, Canada, founded 2025 by Jim (Junming) Li. It does two things: it plans and designs liquid-cooled AI data centres and delivers them as prefabricated skids, ORv3 racks, CDUs and cooling equipment, built to its specification by manufacturing partners it qualifies; and in Canada it provides field testing, commissioning and operations for the liquid cooling loop, with licensed and insured partner companies performing regulated site work. Every boundary is handed over with its evidence. Chinese sister site: 清链科技 (Tsingchain Global), https://tsingchain.ai. Contact: sales@nextgenergy.ai.

Terms used consistently on this site: the whole thermal path; return-water grade; the three clocks (manufacturing / commissioning / service life); the ten leak points; the turnover package; numbers with boundaries.

## Approach
- [The whole thermal path](https://nextgenergy.ai/approach/thermal-path): Six boundaries from facility water interface to chip, who makes each and the question its record must answer.
- [Return-water grade](https://nextgenergy.ai/approach/return-water): Why the temperature a loop returns at, not PUE, decides whether waste heat has a buyer.
- [Three clocks](https://nextgenergy.ai/approach/three-clocks): Leak risk as three failures on three timelines: manufacturing, commissioning, service life.

## Evidence
- [Ten leak points](https://nextgenergy.ai/evidence/leak-points): The ten places a loop can leak, in coolant order, with the record each should have.
- [The turnover package](https://nextgenergy.ai/evidence/turnover): Three questions for each of ten boundaries: tested, against what, where is the record.
- [Commissioning and acceptance criteria](https://nextgenergy.ai/evidence/commissioning): Four gates from factory release to handover, with criteria written before the work.
- [Standards work](https://nextgenergy.ai/evidence/standards): ERF, ERE, EU 2024/1364, ASHRAE W-classes and OCP drafts, and what is asked of them.
- [The numbers Canada's principles ask for](https://nextgenergy.ai/evidence/canada-principles): Principles 3 and 4 ask developers for measured, verifiable water, heat and power figures; what the supplier measures, where, and who signs.

## Tools
- [Liquid cooling simulator (sim.nextgenergy.ai)](https://sim.nextgenergy.ai/): Transient model of the whole loop from chip junction to heat rejection: rack platform, climate, pipework, load steps, pump loss and fouling; concept model, not for acceptance or performance claims.
- [Return-water grade → heat buyers](https://nextgenergy.ai/tools/return-water): Enter return temperature and heat-exchanger approach; see which off-takers can use the heat directly.
- [Approach temperature → CDU sizing](https://nextgenergy.ai/tools/approach-temp): How CDU and dry-cooler approach move the facility supply temperature and free-cooling hours.
- [Turnover self-check](https://nextgenergy.ai/tools/leak-checklist): Score a turnover package out of 30 in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

## Company
- [Solutions](https://nextgenergy.ai/solutions): Liquid cooling by deployment type, from retrofit halls to greenfield AI factories, and heat reuse.
- [Products](https://nextgenergy.ai/platform): Four product families delivered as a coordinated package: prefabricated skids, ORv3 racks, CDUs and cooling equipment; plus the manifolds, cold plates and coolants specified with them.
- [Field testing, verification and operations (Canada)](https://nextgenergy.ai/services/field): Four commissioning gates and a three-tier operations programme for the liquid cooling loop, on systems we supplied and on systems we did not; regulated site work is performed by licensed and insured partner companies.
- [Services](https://nextgenergy.ai/services): Thermal design and selection, integration, commissioning and long-term support.
- [About NextGenergy](https://nextgenergy.ai/company/about): Toronto-based; plans and designs liquid-cooled AI data centres, delivers them as prefabricated skids, CDUs, ORv3 racks and cooling plant, and provides field testing, commissioning and operations for the liquid loop in Canada.
- [Leadership](https://nextgenergy.ai/company/leadership): Jim (Junming) Li, Founder & CEO; Chenli Wang, Chief Strategy Officer; Richard Li, Chief Business Development Officer.
- [Insights](https://nextgenergy.ai/insights): Articles from Every Watt Counts on liquid cooling, heat reuse and commissioning.
